soundness_flags.label: def:budget-set; symbol b; all statements invoking the “published BudgetIV” class
soundness_flags.one_line: The core calls Gamma the published BudgetIV class but permits b1=0 and weakly increasing budgets, whereas Penn et al.'s published BudgetIV definition requires 0<b1<⋯<bK; impose those inequalities or explicitly rename this as a generalized redundant-tier extension.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:whole-set-coverage
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Exact simultaneous containment is conditional on fixed p and finite K, mutually independent exact-Gaussian blocks, and known positive-definite covariance blocks.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Finite-sample whole-set coverage holds only in the stated exact Gaussian subexperiment, not for estimated covariance, residual LD, SNP selection, or approximate GWAS normality.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:complete-inversion and oeq:certified-backend
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The arbitrary-real q branch requires exact-real sign oracles; unconditional termination is only asserted for q-plus on AlgInput.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Completeness at q is oracle-relative; unconditional bit-arithmetic certification is conditional on AlgInput and separately rebuilt q-plus certificates.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:regular-endpoint-limit
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Endpoint, component, pairing, and active-label recovery are conditional on the positive-width regular-face domain.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The joint endpoint limit holds only with nonzero first stages, unique stable active labels, separated components, and a positive exchange-cycle margin.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The published paper defines increasing positive threshold-budget pairs, gives polynomial-time scalar population computation, and gives asymptotic NOME inference.
The preprint develops exact root-based inversion for fixed Anderson-Rubin and Lagrange-multiplier polynomial/rational statistics, plus geometric CQLR inversion.
VIPER proves strong validity for the true beta conditional on a violation set containing the true alpha, and derives pointwise confidence-set coverage.
The paper's two-sample summary-data model assumes independent exposure- and outcome-association estimates and develops asymptotically size-controlled weak-IV tests.
The article gives analytic projection-based AR confidence sets and a necessary-and-sufficient boundedness condition for AR-type confidence sets.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Make the budget domain exactly match Penn et al. by requiring 0<b1<⋯<bK≤p, or label the weak-budget domain as a deliberate generalized redundant-tier extension and prove its reduction to the strict-budget representation.
Make the p=3, K=2 rational equality-tail and optimizer-switch certificate the first completed exhibit, with all six assignment inversions independently serialized and checked.

Add one explicit BudgetIV instance on which fixed-statistic root inversion cannot certify the topology without the exchange-cycle partition, including runtime and component comparison against exhaustive enumeration.

recommended_next_step: Repair the published-BudgetIV budget-domain mismatch, then advance the field-level certified quota-envelope inversion kernel to Stage 0.
